location.title: What supports rental demand around Vila Park.

mobility.title: Mobility
mobility.text: 900 m from Vila Mariana subway (Blue Line 1) and 1.1 km from Ana Rosa (interchange with Green Line 2), the property serves residents who rely on public transport — a relevant factor for tenant retention over time.

university.title: University demand
university.text: Proximity to FMU (850 m), ESPM (1.5 km) and Belas Artes (1.5 km) creates a steady flow of students looking for nearby housing, a traditionally active audience in the rental market.

jobs.title: Employment and leisure hubs
jobs.text: Av. Paulista (2.5 km), one of the city's main employment hubs, and leisure areas like Aclimação Park (950 m) and Ibirapuera (3.1 km) broaden the appeal to professionals seeking to live close to work and leisure.

product.title: Income-focused product
product.text: Studios and 1-bedroom apartments with a more accessible entry ticket, without a parking spot — designed for tenants who walk or use the subway. Common areas will be delivered furnished and decorated, on the ground and 5th floors.

typologies.title: Choosing the right typology for income.
typologies.subtitle: Each floor plan serves a different tenant profile. See what to consider before deciding.
typologies.recommendation: Recommendation: for those seeking greater rental liquidity, the studio/1-bedroom tends to be the most sought-after due to its more accessible entry ticket.

studio.title: 1 bedroom / Studio
studio.profile: Tenant profile: students and professionals who prioritize mobility and practicality, without relying on a car.

garden.title: Apartment with private garden
garden.profile: Tenant profile: those seeking more space and a private outdoor area, such as couples or small families.

terrace.title: Apartment with open terrace
terrace.profile: Tenant profile: residents who value outdoor leisure space and plan to stay longer.

anti.title: Cautions before deciding.
anti.item1: Don't count on guaranteed profitability — the outcome depends on the rental market and property management.
anti.item2: Don't underestimate furniture and setup costs for renting out the unit.
anti.item3: Don't ignore condo fees and property tax in your net return calculation.
anti.item4: Don't decide without simulating the financing.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions for investors
faq.a1: The feasibility of short-term rentals depends on the condominium's bylaws, which have not yet been established. We recommend confirming this with the sales team and, later, with the condo association.
faq.q2: What tenant profile should I expect?
faq.a2: Given the surroundings — subway, universities and employment hubs nearby — the most likely profile is students and young professionals seeking practicality and mobility, without relying on a car.
faq.q3: Is it worth it without a parking spot?
faq.a3: Units without a parking spot were designed to lower the entry ticket and attract an audience that uses public transport — something favored by the mere 900 m distance to Vila Mariana subway.
faq.a4: Use our simulation tool to estimate installments, down payment and term, and talk to the sales team to learn about Vila Park's specific conditions.
faq.q5: When does it start generating income?
faq.a5: Rental income is only possible after the keys are delivered. Talk to the sales team to find out the delivery timeline.
